title: Spring Lake Marina
specs: Access to 10 different lakes north of Route 12 bridge on the Chain O' Lakes
Minimum age to rent is 21; must be 22 to rent or depart with any rental craft
Valid driver's license required; if born on or after Jan 1, 1998, must have Illinois Boating Safety Certificate
No person under 18 may operate any rental craft
Maximum capacity includes all heads on board including babies and small children

options.name: Pontoon & Tritoon Rental
options.detail: 2-hour minimum during Spring/Fall; 6-hour minimum on peak we

variants.label: 2-hour minimum during Spring/Fall; 6-hour minimum on peak we

includes: Safety equipment including throwable life-saving cushion and fire extinguisher
blurb: Guests rent pontoon and tritoon boats to cruise, swim, and explore the Chain O' Lakes. Rentals include safety orientation and access to multiple lakes north of Route 12 bridge. The marina also offers seasonal boat slips, RV sites, and on-site dining.
extraNote: No pets or BBQ grills allowed on rental boats · Arrive 30 minutes before scheduled departure for check-in and safety orientation · No-show reservations are non-refundable; cancellations 72+ hours before get full refund; within 72 hours get rain date credit valid for 1 year · Fuel not included; boats leave with full tank and are topped off on return; customer pays for fuel used · Boat Rental check-in is at the parking lot behind the restaurant, right side parking lot at Spring Lake Marina, Antioch, IL.
